definitions.explanation: A small, quick carnivore of Asia and Africa, famous for fighting snakes. In Japan, mongooses brought to Okinawa and Amami to kill habu snakes became an invasive pest.

examples.japanese: マングース⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ヘビ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
{奄美大島|あまみおおしま}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧マングース⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{進|すす}められた→進める：01949_susumeru⟧。
examples.english: On Amami Oshima, mongoose eradication was carried forward.

examples.japanese: ⟦ハブ→ハブ：11589_habu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{退治|たいじ}する→退治する：25396_taijisuru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{持|も}ち{込|こ}まれた→持ち込む：04226_mochikomu⟧マングース⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{逆|ぎゃく}→逆：02649_gyaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{希少|きしょう}→希少：12444_kishou⟧な⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{襲|おそ}う→襲う：01915_osou⟧ようになった。
examples.english: Mongooses brought in to get rid of habu snakes ended up preying on rare animals instead.

notes:
CULTURAL NOTE:
- Mongooses were released in Okinawa in 1910 and on Amami Oshima in 1979 to fight the venomous habu, but they hunted rare native animals such as the Amami rabbit instead. They are now a designated invasive species ({特定外来生物|とくていがいらいせいぶつ}), and Amami was declared free of them in 2024.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マングース⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦ハブ→ハブ：11589_habu⟧: mongoose against habu (once a tourist show in Okinawa)
- マングース⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{駆除|くじょ}→駆除：16374_kujo⟧: mongoose eradication
